node.statement: From sum_k W_k^*W_k=I_H, each W_j^*W_j<=I_H and hence ||W_j||<=1 and 0<=W_jW_j^*<=I. Applying the positive unital twirl of node 1.2 to W_jW_j^* gives 0<=R_j<=I and the exact formula R_j=I_Lj tensor C_j with C_j:=Tr_Lj(W_jW_j^*)/d_j, so 0<=C_j<=I_Ej and ||R_j||=||C_j||.
